reason: Built papercups witness infrastructure: RFC 6455 frame codec, Phoenix v2 socket stub (join/heartbeat/leave replies plus shout echo) on the upgrade seam, and a frozen synthetic API projection (session, me, accounts, message count, query-disambiguated conversations, body-driven updates, fail-closed unknown paths). Socket handshake and every served frame now enter the response ledger; the api seam receives request bodies. Registered papercups in WITNESS_REAL_APP_NAMES and the AppSpec list with a loopback factory and an explicitly not-yet-implemented journey. Receipt cardinality is now derived from the name list, which the extension required. 20 new tests; full verify block green.
